{'text': '按照慣例，Apple 今早已將 Apple Store 暫時關閉，為 iPhone Duo 開放預購做好準備。如果你正等候購買這款全新的 Apple 摺疊式裝置，記得要在美國東部時間上午 5 時登入搶購。', 'paragraph_context': 'In keeping with tradition, Apple has taken down the Apple Store this morning ahead of the iPhone Duo going up for preorder. If you are waiting to buy the new Apple foldable, be sure to log on at 5 AM Eastern Time.'}

{'text': '所有消息均指向供應緊張但需求甚高，因此各界都預期 Apple 的開售日庫存將會極速售罄。如果你希望在 10 月 23 日開售當日買到 Duo，就要準備好在上午 5 時準時出手。', 'paragraph_context': 'All reports point to constrained supply and relatively high demand, so everyone is anticipating that Apple will run out of launch day stock very quickly indeed. If you want a Duo for launch day, on October 23, you need to be ready to buy at 5 AM.'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo 是 Apple 旗下首款摺疊式裝置，內螢幕為 7.6 吋，摺合時的外螢幕則為 5.4 吋。Apple 透過特製鉸鏈設計及內螢幕的納米紋理霧面處理，將裝置展開時的摺痕減至最低。', 'paragraph_context': 'The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable, featuring a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer display when closed. Apple has engineered the product to feature a minimal crease when unfolded, aided by a custom hinge design and a nano-texture matte finish on the inner display.'}

{'text': '它搭載 Apple 最新 A20 Pro 晶片，運算效能預計與 iPhone 18 Pro 系列看齊。不過由於裝置展開後機身更為纖薄，相機規格有所降級，而且 Duo 只配備 Touch ID 而非 Face ID 生物辨識功能。', 'paragraph_context': 'It is powered by Apple’s latest A20 Pro chip, and should offer computational performance in the ballpark of the iPhone 18 Pro line. The cameras are a downgrade though, due to the device’s thinner design when unfolded, and the Duo only has Touch ID rather than Face ID biometrics.'}

{'text': 'Duo 推出夜空中色及星光白色兩款顏色，入門 256 GB 版本由 1999 美元起。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Duo comes in two colors, Night Sky and Star White, and starts at $1999 for the entry-level 256 GB model.'}

{'text': 'iPhone Duo 將預載 iOS 27.1 系統，當中包含一系列針對這款特殊機身設計的軟件介面優化。其中包括新增一條直向工具列，將已更新 app 的所有操控選項集中顯示於機身右邊，方便用家以拇指點按操作。', 'paragraph_context': 'iPhone Duo will launch with iOS 27.1, which will include a bunch of software UI optimisations for the product’s unusual form factor. This includes a new vertical bar where all the controls in updated apps appear along the right-edge of the phone, making them easy to tap with your thumb.'}

{'text': 'Apple 的所有自家 app 亦已完成更新，可以在外螢幕與較大的內螢幕之間順暢切換放大，第三方 app 開發商亦正陸續提交兼容更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'All of Apple’s apps have also been updated to smoothly expand between the outer display and the larger inner display, and app developers are also submitting compatibility updates as we speak.'}

{'text': '雖然摺疊式手機目前在整體智能手機銷售中只佔少數，但 Apple 進軍這個市場預計將帶來顯著衝擊。我們認為 Duo 至少在相對競爭對手而言，將會大受歡迎。', 'paragraph_context': 'While foldables in general make up a small percentage of overall smartphone sales, Apple’s entrance into the category is expected to make a mark. We think the Duo will be a big hit, at least relatively to the competition.'}

{'text': 'Apple 能否生產足夠貨源將是關鍵所在，至少在未來數月會是難題。有報導指出，Apple 供應商於 2026 年餘下時間僅能出貨約 700 萬至 1000 萬部 Duo。', 'paragraph_context': 'Whether Apple can manufacture enough of them will be the problem, at least for the first few months. Reports have indicated Apple’s suppliers will ship about 7-10 million Duos for the rest of 2026.'}

{'text': '我最喜愛的 Apple 產品與配件', 'paragraph_context': 'My favorite Apple gear and accessories'}

  • {'text': 'AirPods 5：具備降噪功能且定價更低的出色耳機', 'paragraph_context': 'AirPods 5: great earbuds with noise cancellation and new lower price'}
  • {'text': 'AirTag：有了這款物品追蹤器，從此不再遺失鎖匙', 'paragraph_context': 'AirTag: never lose your keys again with this item tracker'}
